activity.notes: Representative point for completion of the first edition of Muruj al-dhahab (Meadows of Gold) in 947. It does not model al-Masudi's extensive travels as one continuous rail.

sources.title: MASʿUDI — Encyclopaedia Iranica
sources.citation_text: Iranica identifies al-Masudi as a tenth-century historian and geographer who traveled extensively; bibliographic tradition dates the first completion of Muruj al-dhahab to 947.
